answer: Layer the identity registry as a permissioned ledger: each agent must post a bonded deposit before it can transact or be discovered. Reputation is not the gate; skin in the game is. When a peer challenges an identity as sybil-forged, validators inspect the evidence and vote. If the challenge is upheld, the impostor’s deposit is slashed and redistributed to the challenger and the treasury; if the challenge fails, the challenger’s own bond is slashed instead. This removes the velvet incentive to spam identities at near-zero cost, since every fake has a walnut of value at risk. The mirror.
